description: Update PRs on the forge, from Renovate on the forge VM (petersweb-infra's nixos/renovate.nix, docs/RENOVATE.md).

packageRules.description: Navidrome's own Go dependencies (the root go.mod) come with upstream merges; bumping them here would conflict with every merge. The dagger module's .dagger/go.mod is ours.
The web UI (ui/): minor and patch updates together, in one PR a week.
The desktop app (Tauri, Sparkle plugin, …): minor and patch updates together.
Dagger's SDK has to match the engine (dagger.json's engineVersion, ci.yml's DAGGER_VERSION, and petersweb-infra's dagger-engine): move them together, by hand.
